description.en: First-person experience and ontology memory for DSH: compiles process events into the character's lived moments, builds queryable work memory (deliveries / entities / task threads), and injects state, recents and ongoing threads before each model step.
description.zh: DSH 第一人称体验与本体记忆插件：把流程事件编译成角色的体验点滴，并从交付/实体/任务线维度建立可回查的工作记忆，在模型步骤前注入此刻状态、刚发生的、被勾起的回忆与正在推进的事。
